newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin and Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn are expected to announce an exceptional rise of the tax targetting businesses, for the year 1997 only, to help curb public deficits. This announcement is to follow that of the outcome of an audit of public finances, on July 21.

-- LVMH luxury goods group chairman Bernard Arnault outlines plan to merge wine and spirits activities with those of Guinness and GrandMet, seeks to hold a 35 percent stake in new unit, in exchange for LVMH's shares in Moet Hennessy, Guinness and GrandMet.
-- Government committed to maintaining public ownership at Framatome nuclear power plant maker, according to union sources.
